content:
Kali SRE: heads-up: ap-southeast1 apiserver 504/502 spike started at 03:42 UTC, kube-controller-manager spamming attach/detach loops for the nvidia-rtx pool. CSI errors + etcd follower lag seen. :rotating_light:
Omar Infra: any infra changes? we pushed a broad MTU bump to 9000 last night but should've been staged.
Lena Eng: logs show a lot of `i/o timeout` and `grpc: the client connection is closing`. etcd raft leader is healthy but follower RTTs jumped and commit latency increased.
Priyanka: CSI controller log snippet:
```
E0502 03:42:21.993 csi-attacher: AttachVolume failed for vol-vol22: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
W0502 03:42:22.010 csi: volume appears attached elsewhere, requeue attach
```
Kali SRE: packet capture on etcd mesh shows large packets with DF set and ICMP "fragmentation needed" replies dropped somewhere -> classic PMTU blackhole. That matches MTU mismatch theory.
Omar Infra: confirmed: two edge routers had their MPLS MTU left at 1500 during the rollout. They silently dropped ICMP 'fragmentation-needed'. Rolling config to force proper PMTU or allow ICMP.
OpsBot: [action] Created incident INC-2026-2400, severity=high, owner=Omar Infra, notify=#oncall.
Lena Eng: mitigation: 1) temporarily reduce controller-manager attach concurrency (`--concurrent-attaches=4`) and increase reconcile period to 180s, canary to 1 replica; 2) disable large MTU on failing nodepool until PMTU works; 3) add tcp-mss clamping on the edge as short-term patch.
Priyanka: applied canary change; leader-election jitter stopped within 45s on the canary. apiserver 5xx/504 rate down.
Kali SRE: Omar, please push edge tcp-mss clamp and fix router MTU/ICMP policy. Also add a preflight check to verify ICMP is allowed post-mtu-roll.
Omar Infra: doing that now, running `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000` on the corrected nodes and applying ACL rule to allow ICMP type 3 code 4.
Kali SRE: cost note 12: attach/detach retries generated ~280 USD in provider attach charges during 18m of thrash. Capture for finance.
OpsBot: [update] INC-2026-2400 severity=investigating -> degraded. Condition: awaiting 30m steady state.
Lena Eng: 03:51 UTC apiserver 5xx down to baseline, controller-manager restarts stopped. Keeping canary for 15m then roll.
Priyanka: will draft postmortem: root cause = partial MTU roll + dropped ICMP fragmentation-needed -> PMTU blackhole -> fragmented etcd traffic and increased commit latency -> controller-manager attach/detach thrash and apiserver errors. Remediations: PMTU preflight, tcp-mss clamping on edges, safer controller-manager defaults, and attach billing alert for ops/finance.
Kali SRE: thanks all — ping if it recurs. :thumbsup:
